post.description: Form fields: file, the fingerprint of the previewed plan, optional decisions, a JSON array of { id, decision } where decision is keep, deactivate (a unit) or dismiss (an employee); a missing unit or employee without a decision is deactivated or dismissed; and optional heads, a JSON array of { unit, employee } with the unit key and the employee key of the preview's heads group, or null as the employee for no head. A missing employee the decisions keep may be chosen by their identifier. A unit without a head choice keeps its head if the employee still works in it, else it is left without a head; the choice is applied after the employees and dismissals, and a choice that names an employee who does not work in the unit is a 400. A 409 whose code is planChanged means the file or the organization no longer give the previewed plan.

order.description: The place of the block among the version's blocks, from 0, in the order the version includes them.

CareerVersionBlock.description: A shared block a matrix version includes, as the version froze it.

CompetencyType.description: How a competency counts towards readiness. Member names are stored and sent in the API, so renaming one changes both.

employeeCount.description: The number of working employees the reason counts.

step.description: The step the reason names: of the matrix builder, or of the approval route.

oneOf.description: The person the reason names, such as a unit head, a responsible HR or whoever holds the turn: their employee, or their account when it is bound to none.
Why the account the reason concerns cannot act.
Why an invitation link no longer works or soon will not.

entries.description: The other records the reason names, in the order it names them.

number.description: The number of the matrix version the reason is about.

hasChanges.description: Whether the approver returned the version with changes of their own.

hasComment.description: Whether the approver returned the version with a comment.

levelCount.description: The number of levels of the track the reason is about, inactive ones aside.

addedLevels.description: The levels a track gained since its matrix was published, in track order.

removedLevels.description: The levels a published matrix lists that its track no longer has in use, in matrix order.

movedLevels.description: The levels whose place in the track changed since its matrix was published, in track order.

hasHrRole.description: Whether the account the reason is about has the HR role.

applicationCount.description: The number of promotion applications the reason counts.

until.description: The last day of the promotion stage the reason names.

hasUnconfirmedEmails.description: Whether some rater of the application has no account and an address that no head or HR has confirmed yet.

DeskDetails.description: The values a desk finding's reason names; the client words the reason from its kind, so each kind fills only the values it names.

DeskInvitation.description: An invitation the user can send again right from the desk, with the account version the request sends back in `If-Match`.

DeskKind.description:
What a desk finding is. Variants of one finding that the desk absorbs differently are separate members.
Member names are sent in the API, so renaming one changes it; a new member also needs its place in the desk's rules.

type.description: What kind of record it is.

name.description: The record's name as shown: a title, a full name or an e-mail address.

context.description: What places the record, such as the units above a unit from the root down; null when the name is enough.

DeskObject.description: A record a desk finding is about or names, with what the desk shows of it.

DeskObjectType.description: The kinds of records desk findings are about or name. Member names are sent in the API, so renaming one changes it.

DeskPrerequisite.description:
A fact about the current data that a desk scenario needs before the user can start it.
Member names are sent in the API, so renaming one changes it; a new member also needs a source that knows it.

ScalePoint.description: One point of a scale: its score and what reaching it means.
